caption: The two dashed arrows read no symbol, so the machine starts in the set {q0, q1} and the moment it reaches q2 it is also in the final q3, giving the set {q2, q3}. A state with no dashed arrow leaving it, such as q1, stands alone.

spec.aria: A four-state machine drawn left to right: q0 loops on a, a dashed epsilon arrow runs from q0 to q1, q1 goes to q2 on b, a dashed epsilon arrow runs from q2 to the double-circled final state q3, and q3 loops on a; small text under q0 shows the set {q0, q1} and under q2 shows the set {q2, q3}.
